analysis_profile_requirements.requirement: Score timestamped probabilities, event boundaries or detections on a frozen cohort.
Include quiet/active speech, idle noise, known positives/negatives and onset/offset delay strata.
Verify independent state, exact source intervals, availability and cross-hop behavior.
Record dropped/stale events and no stale cross-epoch event revival.
Reject malformed, missing and nonfinite inputs; keep validity separate from nonspeech.
Measure paced target-device timing/resources; separate callback suitability from compute speed.
Record missing, invalid, nonfinite and adverse controls without qualifying the candidate.

caller_asset_contract.notes: Every checkpoint/reference-params file, config, licence, rights record, runtime lock, cohort manifest, degradation manifest and parity vector must exist at an absolute path and match its declared SHA-256 before a caller may process audio. No upstream reference revision is pinned because merged evidence records only paper/inventory context and no exact licensed implementation.

exact_blockers.requirement: Supply an exact licensed PCEN reference implementation checkout at an immutable 40-hex revision; no checkout or revision is pinned in this workspace.
Supply exact reference parameters, configs or trained assets with SHA-256 and byte counts; no PCEN asset is present or identified by digest.
Record exact sample rate, frame/hop, FFT/mel geometry, PCEN parameters, channels and streaming/windowing contract; paper context is not an established task geometry.
Provide an isolated hash-pinned runtime with a complete lock and recorded platform; no PCEN runtime exists.
Add upstream reference code/asset licence and terms at the resolved revision; no licence file or redistribution grant is recorded in this workspace.
Clear code, asset, training-data, source-audio, labels and redistribution rights, then freeze a rights-cleared detection/keyword cohort with timestamps and strata.
Produce one approved exact-reference output on a frozen caller input plus analysis-profile detection/keyword quality and independent timing evidence; no local output exists.
Complete opt-in provider intake, descriptor/registry review and independent public-surface/release decision before any exposure; this package makes no such change.

gates.requirement: The full 40-hex source revision, reference params/config/assets and source licence match exact pins.
An isolated hash-pinned runtime with a complete lock is admitted on a recorded platform.
Source, weights/params, training-data, source-audio, labels, output-use and redistribution rights are cleared with notices.
An approved exact-reference PCEN output matches the reference on a frozen caller-supplied input for one frozen configuration.
A rights-cleared held-out detection/keyword cohort scores timestamps, probabilities/events and stratified FP/FN as separate outcomes.
Input/sample/frame/mel/PCEN geometry and scope are established and PCEN is not misrepresented as a waveform loudness controller.
Explicit opt-in provider intake, licence review, descriptor review and an independent public-surface decision are complete.
Explicit default selection, resource/deadline evidence and release or public-benchmark approval are recorded; this package is off by default.

qualification.reason: The PCEN reference implementation, revision, assets/weights, exact geometry, runtime, licence, rights, detection/keyword cohort and parity evidence are absent; no qualifying result exists.

stable_fields.acceptance: Apply the analysis acceptance profile; record exact scope, evidence, failure/control results, and remaining release gates. A readiness conclusion with an exact external blocker is an accepted investigation handoff; it does not close the conditional implementation.
stable_fields.deliverable: Verify runnable source, exact assets, permitted scope, task geometry and matched evidence. Then implement or wrap a minimal reference using the relevant public adapter boundary and ship it as optional initially. Record a concrete blocker if feasibility fails. Test as a feature stage for detection and keyword spotting. Keep waveform loudness under its own task.
